recap.back_html: Transformations (select, filter, withColumn, groupBy, join) describe a new DataFrame. Actions (show, count, collect, write) run the plan.

COUNT(*) counts rows. COUNT(column) counts non-NULL values. SUM and AVG skip NULLs.
